jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is located in the Department of Health & Human Services (HHS), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Center for Medicaid and CHIP Services (CMCS), Managed Care Group (MCG), Division of Managed Care Policy (DMCP).
  
  
As a Data Scientist, GS-1560-13, you will design, develop, & implement various analyses to collect, organize and interpret data sets.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**

Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.

### **Clarification from the agency**

United States Citizens, nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S., and Federal employees who meet the definition of a "surplus" or "displaced" employee.

  

**Duties**
----------

* Collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting Medicaid or Medicaid managed care data sets.
* Developing statistical models, computational algorithms, code, reports, and visualizations.
* Advising CMS leadership on data collection, integration, retention, analysis, interpretation, technology modernization, and communication of analytical findings.
* Leading data science projects by coordinating activities, resolving issues, and monitoring contractor performance and deliverables.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* You must be a U.S. Citizen or National to apply for this position.
* You will be subject to a background and suitability investigation.
* Selective Service: Males born after December 31, 1959, must be registered or exempt from Selective Service - http://www.sss.gov
* One-year probationary period may be required.
* If you are selected for this position, the documentation that you present for purposes of completing the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Form I-9 will be verified through the DHS "E-Verify" System.
* All Federal employees are required to have Federal salary payments made by direct deposit to a financial institution of their choice.

### **Qualifications**

**ALL QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS MUST BE MET BY THE CLOSING DATE OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT.**  
  
**Your resume (limited to no more than 2 pages) must include detailed information as it relates to the responsibilities and specialized experience for this position. Evidence of copying and pasting directly from the vacancy announcement without clearly documenting supplemental information to describe your experience will result in an ineligible rating. This will prevent you from receiving further consideration.**
  
  
**In order to qualify for the GS-13**, you must meet the following: You must demonstrate in your resume at least one year (52 weeks) of qualifying specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal government, obtained in either the private or public sector, to include:

* Applying statistical and data science methods to analyze Medicaid managed care datasets, evaluate program effectiveness, and develop evidence-based recommendations to support decision-making;
* Developing and validating statistical analytical models or predictive analytics using Medicaid managed care data to monitor program or financial performance metrics; and
* Providing technical guidance on Medicaid managed care data requirements and data quality by translating analytical findings into recommendations to improve program operations and performance.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills, and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

### **Education**

**Education Requirement:** In addition to meeting the qualification requirements, all candidates must have the following educational requirements:

* Degree: Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position. The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position. - OR -
* Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown above, plus additional education or appropriate experience.

**TRANSCRIPTS are required** to verify satisfactory completion of the educational requirement listed above. Please see "Required Documents" section below for what documentation is required at the time of application.
  
  
Click the following link to view the occupational questionnaire: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/13125464

### **Additional information**

**Bargaining Unit Position:** Yes
  
**Tour of Duty:** Flexible
  
**Recruitment Incentive:** Not Authorized
  
**Relocation Incentive:** Not Authorized
  
**Financial Disclosure:** Not Required
  
  
**Salary:**
  
Woodlawn, MD = $121,785.00 - $158,322.00
  
Dallas, TX = $115,711.00 - $150,426.00
  
San Francisco, CA = $133,060.00 - $172,980.00
  
  
**Workplace Flexibility at CMS:** This position has a regular and recurring reporting requirement to the CMS office listed in this announcement. CMS offers flexible working arrangements and allows employees the opportunity to participate in alternative work schedules at the manager's discretion.
  
  
**The Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan (ICTAP) and Career Transition Assistance Plan (CTAP)** provide eligible displaced federal employees with selection priority over other candidates for competitive service vacancies. To be qualified you must submit the required document

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Software Engineer)
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join the product engineering team at a Series A fintech company building consumer financial tools. You will deliver end-to-end features that help people manage finances, access pay, and build credit.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build product features end to end, from domain models and business logic to API integrations.
* Deliver incremental releases and iterate on product work using data and performance insights.
* Use SQL and analytics tools to assess product and system performance.
* Debug complex state machines in event-driven systems using pub/sub and message queues.
* Ship production code through CI/CD, own implementations, and respond to production incidents.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 3 years of experience building backend features end to end for production systems, including meaningful early-stage startup experience.
* Experience developing consumer-facing products and working in a high-bar engineering environment.
* Proficiency designing and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, and rate limiting.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues such as Kafka or Pub/Sub, including debugging complex workflows.
* Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including data modeling and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD, version control, automated testing, code reviews, SQL, and analytics tools.
* Strong computer science fundamentals; experience with Go and GCP is useful.
* Based in San Francisco or Seattle, or willing to relocate to either location for on-site work.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $120,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California.

Compensation Range: $120K - $200K

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Backend - Platform Team
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Platform Team**
---------------------------

The Platform Engineering team is the invisible engine that powers all of Rippling's integrated products—HR, IT, and Finance. Our mission is to build the core infrastructure, tools, and shared services that allow every other engineering team to ship highly reliable, secure, and globally scalable features with maximum velocity. We manage the foundational components that ensure Rippling's single, unified platform operates efficiently and securely.

**Our Scope:** Foundational Systems for 1,000+ Engineers

Operating as a critical scaled team, we own and operate a variety of mission-critical systems that directly support close to 1,000 engineers building products and internal platforms across Rippling. We deliver the most foundational shared systems inside the Platform organization.

**What you will do**

* Design, implement, and test reliable backend services and APIs that power core product features and business logic at scale.
* Work across key technical domains, including API design, data modeling, event modeling, and optimizing service performance.
* Own the development lifecycle for defined features, from implementation and testing to deployment, monitoring, and support in a production environment.
* Effectively integrate into cross-functional teams, contribute to technical discovery, and rapidly learn from code and system feedback.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer, preferably with Python, Go, or a similar production language, and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).
* Care about business impact, balancing technical craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly.
* Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs.
* Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer – AI & Talent Marketplace
jobs.description:

This is an opportunity to join an early engineering team and help build products that connect job seekers with relevant career opportunities through intelligent search, AI agents, and scalable data infrastructure.

You will take ownership of projects from initial problem discovery through development and production deployment. Your engineering, data, and product decisions will directly shape the platform and its user experience.

**What You'll Build**

* AI-powered agents that help users discover relevant career opportunities.
* A two-sided marketplace connecting job opportunities with qualified candidates.
* Scalable infrastructure that transforms fragmented web data into structured, searchable information.
* Intelligent search and recommendation experiences powered by large language models.
* Product features that improve job discovery, matching, and user engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using React and Next.js.
* Build scalable backend services, APIs, and data-driven application features.
* Develop and improve search infrastructure using Elasticsearch and Redis.
* Work with Firebase and Stripe to support application services and platform functionality.
* Integrate LLMs and AI-powered capabilities into user-facing products.
* Build and optimize data processing systems that transform fragmented information into structured, searchable datasets.
* Collaborate on product architecture, technical decisions, and user experience improvements.
* Take ownership of engineering projects from research and planning through development, testing, and deployment.
* Identify technical challenges, investigate solutions, and deliver reliable production-ready software.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong full-stack development skills with experience in React and Next.js.
* Experience building and maintaining production web applications.
* Strong understanding of frontend development, backend services, APIs, and application architecture.
* Experience working with databases, search technologies, or scalable data infrastructure.
* Ability to take ownership of projects and deliver solutions independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Willingness to work on-site in Cupertino, California, five days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Firebase, Elasticsearch, Redis, and Stripe.

* Experience taking products from concept to production.

Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.  
  
What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Backend)

Location: New York City, NY (Hybrid — 3 days/week in office)
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
Compensation: $150,000–$275,000 base + equity

About the company

We build AI agents that help healthcare providers get paid for the care they deliver by reducing the operational and financial complexity behind claims and reimbursement. Our team works on automating fragmented workflows and data-heavy processes so healthcare organizations can operate more efficiently and predictably. We’re in a high-growth phase and expanding the engineering team.

About the role

We’re looking for a talented and ambitious Software Engineer with 4+ years of backend experience to build the internal engines and systems that help us scale. As we grow, every new customer adds claims volume, users, and operational complexity. The systems you build will handle high-throughput workflows, automate complex processes, and support reliable, auditable operations.

You’ll work closely with engineering and cross-functional partners (operations, revenue cycle management, finance) to identify the work that consumes the most time, design systems to replace it, ship improvements incrementally, measure impact, and move to the next bottleneck. What you’ll do Examples of projects you may build:

– Automatic claim routing: An allocation engine that dynamically assigns work as volume, priorities, and capacity change
  
– Claims forecasting: Models that predict incoming volume and workload to plan ahead of demand
  
– Staffing rebalancing: Systems that match specialist and BPO capacity to demand across accounts
  
– Custom invoicing: Billing workflows that adapt to customer terms and reconcile automatically
  
Quality & monitoring: Checks that catch process failures before they reach customers
  
– Access & credential automation: Secure, auditable provisioning for portals and internal systems
  
– Internal metrics: Reporting that updates automatically and ties back to source data
  
– Privacy & security: Designing for security and HIPAA compliance from the start

We’d love to hear from you if

– You’re motivated by mission-driven work improving healthcare operations
  
– You have 4+ years of backend engineering experience, especially building data pipelines, integrations, and the infrastructure that supports them
  
– You care about reliable, observable production systems and building for scale
  
– You take ownership of technical roadmaps and can navigate ambiguity
  
– You thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment and are comfortable wearing multiple hats Technical experience
  
– Strong Python skills and experience with database systems, including performance and optimization
  
– Experience coordinating distributed systems and/or AI/data pipelines – Comfort working with large datasets and big data technologies

jobs.title: FDE
jobs.description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (Founding) | Healthcare AI**
========================================================

**Location:** New York City
  
**Employment:** Full-time
  
**Working Model:** Hybrid (3 days/week in office)
  
**Compensation:** $150,000–$275,000 + Equity

**Overview**
------------

We’re a venture-backed healthcare AI company building advanced agents that operate in the real world to solve one of the most painful problems in provider operations: **getting paid accurately and on time.**

Healthcare revenue is often lost to fragmented data, manual workflows, and complex payer systems that don’t talk to each other, creating financial stress for practices and, ultimately, patients.

We take a field-first approach. Before writing software, we worked alongside practices to understand how revenue actually moves through their systems. Now we’re scaling our engineering team to deploy agent-powered workflows that drive measurable outcomes.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring one of our first **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** to build out this function.

You’ll sit between our largest customers and our product team, embedding with healthcare practices to understand workflows, translate real-world requirements into robust agent behavior, and ship production-grade integrations and tooling.

This is an engineering role with a commercial edge. You’ll write code, run working sessions with customer teams, and help turn successful account-specific solutions into reusable product capabilities.

As an early FDE, you’ll help define how deployments work end-to-end, including what gets standardized, what stays bespoke, and how we measure success.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own customer deployments end-to-end, from post-signature onboarding to a live, measurable outcome.
* Integrate customer data sources into our platform, including APIs, data pipelines, exports, and messy real-world systems.
* Configure and refine agent workflows based on payer rules, operational reality, and performance feedback.
* Build account-specific solutions quickly, including agent logic, analyses, automations, dashboards, and internal tooling, then partner with engineering to generalize what works into the core platform.
* Lead working sessions with customer revenue cycle and operations teams to map workflows, identify leakage, and translate that into scoped implementation plans.
* Create and improve SOPs with internal domain specialists to continuously improve agent behavior.
* Partner with the account team on renewals and expansion by communicating outcomes, insights, and technical trade-offs clearly.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, turning field learnings into clear problem statements, specifications, and roadmap input.
* Help build the FDE function, including playbooks, reusable patterns, success metrics, and, over time, team growth.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* **3+ years of professional experience** in software engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or similar.
* Strong execution across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and practical integration work.
* **AI-native mindset:** Hands-on experience with LLMs and agents, including translating business rules into agent logic and debugging failures when outputs are wrong.

* Comfort working directly with customers, running technical workshops, scoping work to outcomes, and communicating trade-offs.
* High ownership and comfort in ambiguity. You can turn one customer conversation into a plan and a working prototype.
* Low ego, growth mindset, and enthusiasm for shaping culture and operating cadence as an early team member.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent practical experience.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Founder or early-stage startup engineering experience.
* Familiarity with healthcare data, revenue cycle management, or payer workflows (not required, but you’ll need to ramp quickly).
* Experience doing the unglamorous data work that makes messy inputs usable.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Competitive base salary:** $150,000–$275,000 depending on experience, plus meaningful equity.
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits.
* Unlimited PTO, with a minimum expectation of 10 days off per year.
* Professional development support, including courses and books.

**Summary**
-----------

This position is located in the Department of Health & Human Services (HHS), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Center for Medicaid and CHIP Services (CMCS), Managed Care Group (MCG), Division of Managed Care Policy (DMCP).
  
  
As a Data Scientist, GS-1560-13, you will design, develop, & implement various analyses to collect, organize and interpret data sets.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**

Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.

### **Clarification from the agency**

United States Citizens, nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S., and Federal employees who meet the definition of a "surplus" or "displaced" employee.

  

**Duties**
----------

* Collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting Medicaid or Medicaid managed care data sets.
* Developing statistical models, computational algorithms, code, reports, and visualizations.
* Advising CMS leadership on data collection, integration, retention, analysis, interpretation, technology modernization, and communication of analytical findings.
* Leading data science projects by coordinating activities, resolving issues, and monitoring contractor performance and deliverables.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* You must be a U.S. Citizen or National to apply for this position.
* You will be subject to a background and suitability investigation.
* Selective Service: Males born after December 31, 1959, must be registered or exempt from Selective Service - http://www.sss.gov
* One-year probationary period may be required.
* If you are selected for this position, the documentation that you present for purposes of completing the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Form I-9 will be verified through the DHS "E-Verify" System.
* All Federal employees are required to have Federal salary payments made by direct deposit to a financial institution of their choice.

### **Qualifications**

**ALL QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS MUST BE MET BY THE CLOSING DATE OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT.**  
  
**Your resume (limited to no more than 2 pages) must include detailed information as it relates to the responsibilities and specialized experience for this position. Evidence of copying and pasting directly from the vacancy announcement without clearly documenting supplemental information to describe your experience will result in an ineligible rating. This will prevent you from receiving further consideration.**
  
  
**In order to qualify for the GS-13**, you must meet the following: You must demonstrate in your resume at least one year (52 weeks) of qualifying specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal government, obtained in either the private or public sector, to include:

* Applying statistical and data science methods to analyze Medicaid managed care datasets, evaluate program effectiveness, and develop evidence-based recommendations to support decision-making;
* Developing and validating statistical analytical models or predictive analytics using Medicaid managed care data to monitor program or financial performance metrics; and
* Providing technical guidance on Medicaid managed care data requirements and data quality by translating analytical findings into recommendations to improve program operations and performance.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills, and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

### **Education**

**Education Requirement:** In addition to meeting the qualification requirements, all candidates must have the following educational requirements:

* Degree: Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position. The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position. - OR -
* Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown above, plus additional education or appropriate experience.

**TRANSCRIPTS are required** to verify satisfactory completion of the educational requirement listed above. Please see "Required Documents" section below for what documentation is required at the time of application.
  
  
Click the following link to view the occupational questionnaire: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/13125464

### **Additional information**

**Bargaining Unit Position:** Yes
  
**Tour of Duty:** Flexible
  
**Recruitment Incentive:** Not Authorized
  
**Relocation Incentive:** Not Authorized
  
**Financial Disclosure:** Not Required
  
  
**Salary:**
  
Woodlawn, MD = $121,785.00 - $158,322.00
  
Dallas, TX = $115,711.00 - $150,426.00
  
San Francisco, CA = $133,060.00 - $172,980.00
  
  
**Workplace Flexibility at CMS:** This position has a regular and recurring reporting requirement to the CMS office listed in this announcement. CMS offers flexible working arrangements and allows employees the opportunity to participate in alternative work schedules at the manager's discretion.
